name: Gratis
source:
A shop has opened, the shopkeep has moved in, and shoppers need assistance. A quick salve, a trifle, salvation. Help them.

[From [url=https://marlowedobbe.itch.io/gratis]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
店开张了，店主搬进来了，客人们需要帮忙。有人急需一剂药膏，有人要一件小玩意儿，有人求救赎。帮帮他们。

［摘自[url=https://marlowedobbe.itch.io/gratis]itch.io[/url]］
